title: Who Says You Can't Go Home
description: Bon Jovi's 2005 single about coming back to the New Jersey hometown the band once wanted to escape. A country duet version with Jennifer Nettles of Sugarland later topped the Billboard country chart.
tz_connection: The first verse uses the show's name as an idiom: the narrator describes himself as a wanderer lost in the twilight zone before finding his way home.
lyric_excerpt: I was a gypsy lost in the twilight zone
recommendation_reason: A huge mainstream hit that drops the show's name in its opening verse, a good example of how the title became everyday English.
